subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this issue remain the canonical broad tracker for WebChat project/topic organization and multi-AI collaboration, and which remaining parts should OpenClaw core own?
rationale: Current main covers a useful flat-session subset, while the remaining request crosses Control UI UX, Gateway/session metadata, project organization, and multi-agent orchestration boundaries that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project/topic organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

options.title: Narrow Core Scope
options.body: Limit core work to session/project organization and route committee, meeting, and consensus workflows to plugin or RFC work until a missing core API is proven.

options.title: Close After Transfer
options.body: Close this umbrella only after the remaining requirements are moved to clearly canonical narrower issues for projects, topic trees, and multi-agent collaboration.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project/topic organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical-tracker signal and authored the recent session-management foundation that any accepted milestone would build on.
